title: Interactivity
heading: Interactive digital art
description: Early Meta-art: Open Form and Interactivity in the nineteensixties.

blocks.text:
User-driven exploration. Passive,
static environments. The user navigates. The computer is
essentially a storage device. [Typically: Network topologies:
hypertext, hypermedia.]

Interactive, dynamic environments. [Often: simulated
3D environment ("virtual reality").]

The user gets building blocks, to make whatever she wants.
Typically, the space of possibilities is virtually infinite.
For instance: programming languages, paint programs, virtual
lego.

and Media in the XX. century. [History of MultiMedia
